reference_sql:
SELECT l.order_line_id, o.order_ts, s.city, c.category_name, p.product_name, l.quantity, l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur AS net_revenue_eur
FROM order_lines l
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE o.ship_to_country = 'BE'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-04 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-05 00:00:00'
alternatives: SELECT s.order_line_id, o.order_ts, st.city, s.category_name, s.product_name, s.units, s.net_revenue_eur FROM sales s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id JOIN stores st ON st.store_code = s.store_code WHERE o.ship_to_country = 'BE' AND s.order_date = DATE '2025-03-04'

SELECT l.order_line_id, o.order_ts, s.city, c.category_name, p.product_name, l.quantity, l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur AS net_revenue_eur FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.ship_to_country = 'BE' AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-03-04'
